Lemma
[Conjugate points and the differential of $\exp _p$] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0305 ↗ appb-def-conjugate-point 1. Lemma B.11\group local-comparison-geometry

A point $\exp _p(V)$ is conjugate to $p$ if and only if there exists a nonzero $W\in T_p\mathcal M^n$ orthogonal to $V$ such that $(\exp _p)_*(W_V)=0$.
